question: What are the names of the singers that have more than one songs?
sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s
JOIN (
    SELECT Singer_ID
    FROM song
    GROUP BY Singer_ID
    HAVING COUNT(Song_ID) > 1
) sq ON s.Singer_ID = sq.Singer_ID;
